## About
David's Auto Central is a full service auto repair and maintenance shop in Stafford, Texas. We work on everything from daily drivers to rare classics. Classics, antiques and motorhomes are welcome here, along with all modern cars and trucks.
The shop is technician owned, and our work covers diagnostics, brakes, electrical, engine, transmission, air conditioning, alignments, tires and custom jobs. We also handle fleet maintenance as a vendor for fleet leasing companies including ARI, Wheels and Enterprise.
We hold a 4.5 rating from 124 Google reviews. One reviewer wrote that Melissa at the front desk has always been friendly and efficient, and another said we kept them informed through every step of fixing a project car's axle issues.

## Services
- Computer diagnosis: We track down check engine, ABS and SRS warning light problems.
- Air conditioning: Air conditioning service and repair.
- Transmission and clutch: Repair work on transmissions and clutches.
- Steering and suspension: Steering and suspension repairs to keep your vehicle handling right.
- State safety and emission inspections: Texas state safety and emission inspections done at the shop.
- Classic car mechanical restoration: Mechanical restoration for classics and antiques, plus carb to fuel injection conversions.
- Customization and modifications: Custom work and modifications to make your vehicle your own.
- Motor home service and repair: We service and repair motorhomes.
- Fleet maintenance: Maintenance for business fleets. We are a vendor with fleet leasing companies including ARI, Wheels and Enterprise.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on older or unusual vehicles?
A: Yes. Classics, antiques and motorhomes are welcome, along with all modern cars and trucks.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We accept all major credit cards.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday. Call ahead to confirm hours.
